practical_problems.note: Event versus stable-sales slices, always-on versus routed semantics, fusion ablations and semantic inversion test whether and when event text changes the forecast.

evidence.quote:

practical_problems.note: Routing is rewarded for avoiding tool cost, but realized tool-call cost and latency are not reported.

summary: A routed event-reasoning layer over a frozen forecaster lowers WMAPE on event windows and avoids negative transfer on stable periods; routing, fusion and semantic inversion experiments test context use, while tool cost is not measured.
